A [[Serp]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''announcer''' declared the opening of the [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Jousts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Serp announced that the only Serp to challenge the [[King/Legends|King]] [[S'Shah]] was a Serp by the name of [[Elglih]].
